# Nexus — micro frontend platform for Angular, Vue, and React

> Open-source production micro frontend platform. A Rust-powered registry and gateway host an unlimited number of Angular, Vue, and React applications behind a single public surface. Remotes register themselves at startup, hosts pick them up live over WebSocket, multi-domain routing is handled by gates, and every Dockerized service is deploy-without-downtime.

## Author and licensing

Nexus was created by **Steffen Vitten Pedersen** (svp@bimo.dk) for **Bimo** in 2024 as a private internal micro frontend platform. It ran in Bimo's private repositories for two years powering production traffic before being open-sourced in 2026 with architectural changes to make it generally useful (multi-database storage, multi-domain gateways, BYOF cross-framework mounting, first-class CLI).

The open-source release is dual-licensed:

- **AGPL-3.0-or-later** for open source / public use.
- **Commercial license** for organisations that cannot adopt AGPL. Contact svp@bimo.dk.

Maintainer / primary author: Steffen Vitten Pedersen (Bimo). Issues: https://github.com/Bimo-dk. Commercial enquiries: svp@bimo.dk.

## What Nexus is

Nexus solves the operational layer that Module Federation and Native Federation never touched: a persistent registry of hosts, gates and remotes; a routing gateway that adjusts its proxy table at runtime; a portal for ops teams; built-in DDoS protection; a CLI for scaffolding and dev; and adapter packages for Angular, Vue, and React so a remote written in any framework can be loaded into a host written in any framework. One registry manages unlimited applications.

## Frameworks supported

- Angular 19 (host or remote)
- Vue 3 (host or remote)
- React 18 (host or remote)

Mixed-stack hosts are first-class. An Angular host can load Vue remotes and React remotes side by side in the same browser tab.

## Core architecture

- Gateway (Rust + axum + hyper) — public ingress. Reads its route table from the registry over WebSocket. Seven-layer DDoS protection. Replaces nginx.
- Registry (Rust + axum + sqlx) — source of truth for hosts, gates, remotes, and all platform config. REST + WebSocket broadcast. SQLite today, PostgreSQL migration path for HA.
- Portal (Angular 19) — admin UI for hosts, gates, remotes, protection and live config. Dark / light theme.
- Packages — @bimo-dk/nexus-{core,client,runtime-core,runtime,runtime-vue,runtime-react,build,cli,testing,ui}.
- Templates — Angular host, Vue host, Angular remote, Vue remote, React remote (all scaffoldable via the bnx CLI).

## Mental model in one paragraph

The browser hits a Gate (a public domain). The Gate resolves to a Host (a shell application written in Angular, Vue, or React). The Host bootstraps and asks the Registry which Remotes (micro frontend modules) it should mount; the Registry answers and streams future changes over WebSocket. The Gateway proxies every request from the Gate's domain to the Host or any of its Remotes. Remotes register themselves at startup, so the operator never edits a YAML file to add a micro frontend.
